summary: Vale S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its newly published Circular Mining Policy (POL-0040-G, v01), approved under deliberation DDE-078/2026 and dated 2026/09/21, with review scheduled for 2031/09/21. The policy sets guidelines for reducing tailings and mining waste generation, reuse, R&D, geochemical characterization and risk management across Vale and subsidiaries, referencing existing dam-safety, climate, water and sustainability policies. No transaction, security, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or structural mechanic is disclosed. Not a special situation; no deal terms. Watch only for policy-driven capex or tailings-liability disclosure.
